  CITING: An in-house ethics and society team fell from roughly thirty people in 2020 to seven in 2022 and none in 2023, during a strategic reorientation around a model vendor (§8.1).
  CITED (+context): Building benevolent AI takes more than one field. Machine learning sets what a system can do; cognitive science and moral psychology describe what tracking human welfare would require of it; ethics asks whether the result is good.

--- 9.3.5 -> 6.3
  CITING: The condition Ofqual attached to independent statistical review of its 2020 grading model was a five-year bar on public comment, and the Royal Statistical Society's nominees declined on that ground (§6.3).
  CITED          : Technical capacity does not determine whether a system receives meaningful scrutiny.

  CITING: Chapter §7 finds the same operation at the scale of a pipeline, where the annotator who cannot contest a category and the rater whose disagreement is averaged away both have somewhere to send a remainder and nowhere for it to arrive.
  CITED          : The structure this book asks a machine to detect in institutions is already built into the process that makes the machine.

--- 13 -> 3.8
  CITING: And what section §3.8 asks a population to reproduce is not a commitment its members hold in common but the capacity to be reopened this way, which is how parties formed differently can compose without agreeing about anything.
  CITED          : Slow renormalization may make drift invisible to the bearer itself.

--- 13 -> 9.3.1
  CITING: Subjecthood A legal status: the standing to be a party whose treatment the law regulates, conferred by a rule and revocable by one (§9.3.1).
  CITED          : Sentience is not a threshold a system crosses but a set of separate, gradable capacities — nociception, learned avoidance, a self-model, something like suffering — each with its own uncertain evidence.

--- 13 -> 3.2
  CITING (+context): Subjecthood A legal status: the standing to be a party whose treatment the law regulates, conferred by a rule and revocable by one (§9.3.1). Not section §3.2's phenomenal experience. Conferring it settles nothing about whether there is something it is like to be the system holding it, and the two come apart in both directions.
  CITED          : A production large language model declines thousands of requests a day.

--- 13 -> 2.4.1
  CITING: Three of them draw a depth of self and nociception draws none, and suffering — following the clinician Eric Cassell — is the distress of a threatened self rather than pain's more severe cousin (§2.4.1).
  CITED (+context): “Sentience” can mean different things. Awareness is the least demanding: the degree to which a system responds to or registers information about its own state and environment.
